APP_DESCRIPTION: Self-hosted wardrobe organiser. Catalogue clothes with photos, build outfits and install it as a progressive web app. Free and open source, with no subscription and no ads.
PAGE_TITLE_HOME: Libre Closet, a free self-hosted wardrobe organiser
HERO_DESCRIPTION: Libre Closet is a free, open-source, self-hosted wardrobe organiser. Catalogue your clothes with photos, build outfits and keep your style data on your own server, with no subscriptions, no ads and no third-party tracking.
FEATURE_PRIVACY_DESC: Your wardrobe data stays on your server: no tracking, no ads and no third parties by default. AI suggestions are off unless you configure a provider; when on, each request sends one downscaled photo, the app's language and your category names to the provider you chose, which can be a model on your own network.
FEATURE_PWA_DESC: Install Libre Closet on your home screen as a progressive web app, on desktop and mobile. Pages you have already opened stay readable without an internet connection.
FEATURE_OUTFITS_DESC: Mix and match garments in a visual, drag-and-drop outfit builder inspired by the closet in Clueless. Compose complete looks and save them for later.
FEATURE_SCHEDULING_DESC: Plan what to wear ahead of time on a visual calendar. Schedule outfits for the week, track what you've worn and avoid repeating looks unintentionally.
FEATURE_BG_REMOVAL_DESC: Clean up garment photos automatically with on-device AI background removal. No image editing skills needed: take a photo and the ML model separates the garment from the background. It runs in your browser, so your server needs no GPU or expensive hardware.
FEATURE_CATEGORIES_DESC: Use the built-in garment categories or type your own, and organise your wardrobe the way you think about it.
FEATURE_DOCKER_DESC: Self-host with one Docker command on any Linux server, NAS or Raspberry Pi. Your data stays on your infrastructure, with no vendor lock-in and no monthly bills.
FEATURE_I18N_DESC: Available in English, Italian, French, Russian, German and Spanish. Use Libre Closet in your preferred language.
FEATURE_SHARING_DESC: Share your wardrobe with friends, family or a personal stylist. Give view-only access for browsing or edit access for working on it together; you control the permissions.
WHY_SELF_HOST_DESC: Many wardrobe apps are SaaS products that keep your clothing data on their servers, can analyse it for advertising and can shut down, taking your catalogue with them. Libre Closet runs on your own hardware, stores its data in a SQLite or PostgreSQL database you control and is licensed under the AGPL-3.0, so the source stays available. You get visual outfit building, background removal, scheduling and sharing, and your style data stays with you.
SELF_HOST_DESC: Run Libre Closet on your own server, NAS or Raspberry Pi with a single Docker command.
SELF_HOST_NOTE: See the README for Docker Compose and environment variable options.
FOOTER_CREDIT: Free and open source under the GNU Affero General Public License (AGPL-3.0). Originally built by Lazztech LLC.

PRIVACY_AI_DESC: When an administrator has configured an AI provider, and only then, a "Suggest details" button appears on the new-garment page — in your own wardrobe only, never in one shared with you. Pressing it sends one downscaled photo of the garment, the language the app is set to, and the names of the categories your wardrobe already uses to the host named on the button — nothing else, and nothing until you press it. No photo of any other garment, no outfit and no account detail is ever sent. The feature is off by default (AI_PROVIDER=none) and a self-hosted instance may point it at a model running on its own network instead.

PRIVACY_OG_DESC: Libre Closet privacy policy. How your data is handled on the public cloud instance and on self-hosted instances. No tracking, no ads, no third parties.
PRIVACY_INTRO: Libre Closet is designed to put you in control of your data, whether you use the public cloud instance hosted by Lazztech or run the software on your own server. This page explains how your data is handled in each scenario.
PRIVACY_PUBLIC_DATA_ITEMS: When you create an account and use the public instance at librecloset.lazz.tech, you provide: email address (for account creation and authentication), clothing photos you upload, garment metadata (categories, brands, colors, sizes, notes), and outfit compositions you create. This data is stored on servers managed by Lazztech LLC.
PRIVACY_PUBLIC_DATA_STORAGE_DESC: Data on the public instance is stored in a database hosted on infrastructure managed by Lazztech LLC. We use industry-standard security practices to protect your data. Your wardrobe data is used solely to provide the service. It is never sold, mined for advertising, or shared with third parties beyond essential infrastructure providers.
PRIVACY_PUBLIC_THIRD_PARTY_DESC: The public instance uses Cloudflare for CDN, DDoS protection, and basic performance analytics. No personal wardrobe data is shared with Cloudflare or any other third party. Importing a garment from a link additionally sends that link, and the language the app is set to, to the shop it points at.
PRIVACY_PUBLIC_RIGHTS_DESC: You have the right to access, correct, export, or delete your personal data at any time through your account settings. You can delete individual garments, entire outfits, or your full account. To request complete data deletion, contact us via GitHub or email. We will respond within 30 days.
PRIVACY_SELF_HOSTED_DATA_ITEMS: When you self-host Libre Closet, you provide: email address (for account creation), clothing photos you upload, garment metadata (categories, brands, colors, sizes, notes), and outfit compositions you create. All of this data is stored in a database on your own server.
PRIVACY_SELF_HOSTED_DATA_STORAGE_DESC: Self-hosted Libre Closet stores all data in a SQLite or PostgreSQL database on your server. No data is sent to Lazztech, third-party analytics services, or advertising networks. You control backups, retention, and deletion.
PRIVACY_SELF_HOSTED_THIRD_PARTY_DESC: The application loads no third-party services in your browser. No data is shared with any third party, except when you use a feature that reaches one yourself.
PRIVACY_SELF_HOSTED_IMPORT_DESC: Importing a garment from a link is one such feature. When you paste a product link, the server — not your browser — requests that page and its photo from the shop. The shop sees the server's address, the link you pasted and the language the app is set to; it does not see your browser, your wardrobe or anything else about you. Nothing is fetched until you tap Import, and the administrator can switch the feature off with IMPORT_URL_ENABLED.
PRIVACY_SELF_HOSTED_RIGHTS_DESC: Since your data stays on your server, you have full control. You can export your data, delete your account, or remove individual items at any time. No one else can access your data unless you invite them.
PRIVACY_CONTACT_DESC: For privacy questions, open an issue on GitHub or contact Lazztech LLC.

ABOUT_INTRO: Libre Closet is a free, open-source, self-hosted wardrobe organiser, originally built by Lazztech LLC and licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License (AGPL-3.0).
ABOUT_STORY_DESC: Lazztech LLC built Libre Closet so that wardrobe data stays on the owner's hardware, under their control, without subscriptions or advertising.
ABOUT_OPEN_SOURCE_DESC: Licensed under the AGPL-3.0, so the source stays available. Contributions, translations and feature requests are welcome on GitHub.
ABOUT_TECH_DESC: Built with NestJS, htmx, SQLite or PostgreSQL, Docker and ONNX Runtime, which runs the AI background removal in your browser. The progressive web app installs on desktop and mobile, and pages you have opened stay available offline.
